shared_elements: short transverse marks on/near a curved band
justification: The most specific formal overlap is that both include schematic circular marks and curved horizontal bands or arcs with short cross-marks, although in A these are integrated into a frontal anthropomorphic body while in B similar arcs read as boat-like forms among animals and other signs. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal human-like figure with body parts and torso markings, whereas B is a dispersed scene of boats, quadrupeds, dots, and small linear figures with no comparable central anthropomorphic scheme.
